October 2nd, 2072
Dr Amit Chaudhry-Lund Orthopaedics
Re: Mr Sorensen, 48
Dear Dr Chaudhry-Lund,
I would be grateful if you would see this forty-eight-year-old man with a three month history of right knee pain, worse on stairs and after sitting, with some morning stiffness lasting under half an hour. Examination today showed crepitus and a small effusion, and I have diagnosed osteoarthritis of the knee. Radiographs were obtained. He has known coronary disease on clopidogrel, simvastatin and metoprolol, with emphysema and sleep apnea, and I have started naproxen 220 mg, which I will review in view of the clopidogrel. This is dictated and has not been read.
Kind regards, Hyun-woo Baek, MD
